entities.summary: Bolkiah, a notable figure in the history of Brunei, associated with Sultanate of Brunei Golden Age (1485–1524). Preceded by Zenith Under Sultan Bolkiah and Chinese Ming. Their legacy influenced Sultan Bolkiah extends Bruneian control over Manila and the Sulu Archipelago and Spanish Encounters and Contestation.
